diagnosis: Bad runs disproportionately repeat actions without progress: 1,485 repeated operations versus 224 in good runs (net +1,261). Repetition constitutes 20.2% of bad operations versus 5.9% of good operations, a 3.40× relative rate.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged outcomes interrupts unproductive loops and forces a state reassessment or strategy change. The cost is additional comparison/replanning and occasional premature abandonment when repetition would eventually succeed.
policy_text: Before repeating an action, compare the latest state and result with the previous attempt. If they are materially unchanged, do not retry unchanged: reassess assumptions, inspect available state, and choose a different action or strategy. Permit one justified retry only when a concrete transient failure is evident.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated") | [.value, .labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '{if($1>0){b+=$1;bs[$2]=1}else{g+=-$1;gs[$2]=1};net+=$1} END{for(x in bs)nb++;for(x in gs)ng++;printf "bad_repeated=%d good_repeated=%d net=%+d bad_sessions=%d good_sessions=%d\n",b,g,net,nb,ng}'
quantitative_evidence.finding: bad_repeated=1485, good_repeated=224, net=+1261; repeated behavior appears in 88 bad-side sessions versus 20 good-side sessions.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r '[.value, .labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '{if($1>0)b+=$1;else g+=-$1} END{printf "all_bad=%d all_good=%d bad_repeated_rate=%.2f%% good_repeated_rate=%.2f%% ratio=%.2fx\n",b,g,100*1485/b,100*224/g,(1485/b)/(224/g)}'
quantitative_evidence.finding: all_bad=7366 and all_good=3780; repeated-operation rates are 20.16% and 5.93%, respectively, yielding a 3.40× bad/good ratio.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated") | [.stack_frames[2],.value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '{if($2>0)b[$1]+=$2;else g[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in b) printf "%s bad=%d good=%d net=%+d\n",k,b[k],g[k],b[k]-g[k]}' | sort
quantitative_evidence.finding: Major excesses are repeated clicks (+639), no-ops (+356), and scrolls (+277), showing recurrence across several action types rather than one isolated command.
